title: Sentinel-SLA incident event envelope
description: Wire format for a single Sentinel-SLA incident event as emitted by the alerting pipeline (and consumed by the event collector / executive translator). It carries BOTH languages of the product: the technical identification (service, severity, timestamps) and the executive payload (financial_impact_tomans, lost_transactions). Owner: Sentinel-SLA.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier — a UUID (format: uuid; draft-07 validators treat format as annotation-only, so generate v4 UUIDs upstream).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 timestamp of when the event was raised.

service.description: Service key (stable identifier) the event refers to, e.g. 'ps-gateway'.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the associated Sentinel incident, when known.

audience.description: Which language the message field is written in: metrics for engineers, Tomans for the CEO.

financial_impact_tomans.description: Revenue + penalty exposure attributed to the incident, in Tomans (تومان). Executive payload.

lost_transactions.description: Number of customer transactions lost during the incident. Executive payload.

message.description: Human-readable summary — English for technical audience, Persian (فارسی) acceptable for executive audience.
